fields.summary: ETIM class and feature mapping for supplier imports
fields.description:
As a classification specialist I want ETIM classes and features from supplier files mapped to our attributes so that products are classified on import.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The supplier column "etim_class" is mapped to the dictionary attribute "etim_class" for every imported SKU.
2. The legacy supplier column "etim" is also accepted and mapped to the attribute "etim_class".
3. The supplier column "ip_rating" is mapped to the ETIM feature attribute "ip_rating".
4. Every ETIM class code is validated against the latest official ETIM release published by ETIM International.
